Clearance in the 12 additional countries (including China, Brazil, India and the GCC states) will involve local searches and opinions from associates in each jurisdiction. We estimate around $38,000 in total on top of the US/EU work already approved.

Let us know and we'll instruct the agents.

Best,
Tom Harlow

subject: Rates following the Linden/Hart combination
body:
Dear Client,

As you know, Linden & Co. and Hartwell Price completed their combination on 1 October. To bring our two fee scales into line, rates for former Hartwell Price timekeepers will move to the Linden Hart scale from 1 December. For your matters this affects:

- Owen Burke: $710 to $760
- Lucy Tran: $520 to $555
- Marco Ruiz (paralegal): $240 to $260

We will reflect the new rates on invoices for December work onwards.

Linden Hart Client Relations

subject: Appeal - budget if we go forward
body:
Dear Thomas,

If Westmark decides to appeal, the appeal will need its own budget, since the current budget runs only through final judgment. Our estimate for the appeal (record review, opening and reply briefs, oral argument) is $210,000 to $260,000.

We don't need a decision until the judgment is entered, but we wanted you to have the number for your planning.

Kind regards,
Helen Galloway

subject: Divisional filings - '882 family
body:
Hi Mark,

The restriction requirement in the '882 application splits the claims into three groups. To keep coverage of the sensor and calibration claims, we recommend filing two divisional applications. That is new work outside the prosecution budget we agreed for this family. We estimate about $22,000 in fees and costs for both, including drafting the divisional claim sets.

Shall we proceed?

Eva Lindqvist
